field_updates.detail: Fig. 4 - Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage (white; log 1-100 mA vs 2-5 V; Tamb = 25 °C). Read points: 1.00 mA @ 2.859 V (resid +9.4 mV); 2.00 mA @ 2.963 V (resid -14.1 mV); 5.00 mA @ 3.187 V (resid +1.1 mV); 10.00 mA @ 3.413 V (resid +1.4 mV); 20.00 mA @ 3.767 V (resid +6.8 mV); 30.00 mA @ 4.061 V (resid -4.5 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=3.760 V vs stated typ 3.70 V (+60 mV); "Forward voltage IF = 20 mA VF - 3.7 4.2 V" (p2). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector path itself (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from the drawn gridline coordinates; read points interpolated on the drawn centreline (log I). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 6 points 1.00-30.0 mA, rms 7.7 mV. Window sensitivity: windows 1-20..5-30 mA give N 5.6-7.0, RS 21.4-26.1 ohm. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
